parent_objective: design multi-training-seed repeat to test whether M2174 profile differences are stable
blocked_by: M2175 classifies M2174 as one-seed smoke evidence and not ranking-ready
supersedes: direct controller ranking from M2174 one-seed aggregates

public_gates: M2176 must freeze a multi-training-seed repeat design
M2176 must preserve the same 40 specs and 8 profile definitions
M2176 must keep L3_reset_control as same-seed alias to L3_online_gru
M2176 must not train, rerun measured execution, rank profiles, or claim paper evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns one-seed measured execution into a controlled repeat plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repeat design only; no training measured execution ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if repeat seeds or budgets are ambiguous
stop if repeat changes task specs or profile definitions
stop if reset-control alias policy is not same-seed
stop if design enables ranking without audited repeat results
fallback_plan: route to repeat materialization implementation if design is complete
route to synthesis if repeat scope is too large for current branch
route to task-quality repair design if repeat would not address offtrack dominance
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2175 audit routes to training-seed repeat design

training_stage.stage_objective: design controlled repeat protocol for training seed reliability
admission_evidence: M2175 audits M2174 as complete but one-seed and offtrack-dominated
M2174 produces nontrivial profile-dependent behavior but not paper-grade comparison
allowed_updates: M2176 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for repeat materialization implementation or synthesis
next_stage_criteria: workload/eval seed reuse policy is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2176 designs reliability repeats and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2176.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2174 measured execution and M2175 audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repeats are unstable, classify seed fragility instead of ranking profiles.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds reliability axis by planning repeat seeds rather than optimizing the observed one-seed result
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit repeat-data generation but cannot decide final comparison
must_synthesize_if: M2176 cannot define repeat seeds and budgets
M2176 would rank profiles from M2174 alone
M2176 expands into unrelated task redesign

hypothesis: A controlled repeat design can test whether M2174 profile differences survive training-seed variation without changing tasks, inputs, or profiles.
success_criteria: training budget and profile alias policy are explicit
evaluation workload and eval seed reuse policy are explicit
no training rerun ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: profile definitions or actor inputs change
ranking or paper-level claims are made
decision_rule: M2176 passes if it freezes a repeat protocol that can test training-seed reliability before any ranking or paper claim.
